newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's inflation rate 16.5 pct at end 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's inflation rate 16.5 pct at end 1996.

text.p: Algeria's inflation rate fell to 16.5 percent at the end of 1996 from 29 percent in 1995, Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia said on Sunday.

Ouyahia, quoted by the Algerian official news agency APS as addressing the government-appointed Social and Economic National Council in Algiers, said the government expected a rate of no more than 10 percent in 1997.
The bank interest rate was 15 percent at the end of 1996 from 18.5 percent in 1995 and the government forecast more easing in this rate in 1997, Ouyahia said.

"This stabilisation should enable private and state-run business to launch investment projects," he added, referring to previous complaints by entrepreneurs over high interest rates hindering their activities.
